description:
Send messages to an OpenRouter chat model and get a text reply. Supports provider routing, model suffixes (`:nitro` fastest, `:floor` cheapest, `:free` zero-cost, `:online` web search, `:exacto` tool accuracy), reasoning tokens, reasoning effort control (`reasoning_effort`), web search (`online: true`, `web_max_results`, `web_blocked_domains`), structured output (`response_format`), response caching, multi-model fusion (`fusion: true`), subagent delegation (`subagent: true`), JSON response healing, standard sampling controls (`temperature`, `top_p`, `stop`, `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`), log probabilities (`logprobs`, `top_logprobs`), and deterministic output (`seed`).

Use when:
- You need text generation, Q&A, summarization, or multi-turn dialogue
- You want web-grounded answers (`online: true`)
- You want multi-model consensus (`fusion: true`) for critical decisions
- You want the model to delegate busywork to a cheaper model (`subagent: true`)
- You need reliable JSON output (`response_healing: true` or `response_format: { "type": "json_object" }`)
- You need structured output conforming to a JSON Schema (`response_format: { "type": "json_schema", ... }`)
- You want to control reasoning depth for thinking models (`reasoning_effort: "low"` / `"medium"` / `"high"`)
- You already know the model id (or rely on the server default)

Do NOT use when:
- Input is a single image/audio/video file → use analyze_image / analyze_audio / analyze_video (dedicated wrappers)
- You need to create images, audio, or video → use generate_* / text_to_speech tools
- You only need to check if a model exists → use validate_model
- You need a structured yes/no, choice, or score decision with calibrated probabilities → use decide
- You need vector embeddings for RAG or semantic search → use embed_text
- You need to rerank documents by relevance to a query → use rerank_documents

Good examples:
- `{ "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain recursion in one paragraph." }] }`
- `{ "model": "openai/gpt-4o:nitro", "messages": [...], "online": true }` for web search
- `{ "messages": [...], "online": true, "web_blocked_domains": ["example.com"], "web_max_results": 10 }` for filtered web search
- `{ "messages": [...], "include_reasoning": true }` for chain-of-thought models
- `{ "messages": [...], "reasoning_effort": "high" }` for maximum reasoning depth on thinking models
- `{ "messages": [...], "response_format": { "type": "json_object" } }` for JSON mode

Bad examples:
- `{ "messages": [] }` → INVALID_INPUT (empty array)
- `{ "image_path": "photo.jpg" }` → wrong tool; use analyze_image
- Putting file paths inside message content without a vision model configured
- `{ "messages": [...], "response_format": { "type": "json_schema" } }` → INVALID_INPUT (json_schema requires json_schema field)

Fails when:
- INVALID_INPUT: messages array is empty
- UPSTREAM_REFUSED: credits, content policy, or rate limit
- UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: upstream did not respond in time
- MODEL_NOT_FOUND: model slug does not exist on OpenRouter

Works with: validate_model, search_models, embed_text, decide, rerank_documents.

cache.description: Enable OpenRouter response caching via `X-OpenRouter-Cache: true`. Server default: `OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES=1`.

cache_clear.description: Bust the cache entry for this exact request.

cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL as integer seconds (1–86400) or a duration string such as "30s", "5m", or "1h". Sent upstream as seconds.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far. Between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values reduce repetition.

fusion.description: Enable `openrouter:fusion` — multi-model deliberation. Multiple models answer in parallel, an analyst synthesizes. Higher quality but ~2-5x latency.

include_reasoning.description: Surface the model's chain-of-thought on `_meta.reasoning` for R1 / Opus / Gemini Thinking models.

logprobs.description: Return log probabilities of output tokens. When true, each token includes its log probability in `_meta.logprobs`.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens. Falls back to `OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS` env var if unset.

model.description: Model ID (optional, uses server default). Append `:nitro` (fastest), `:floor` (cheapest), `:free`, `:online` (web search), or `:exacto` (tool accuracy). Example: `openai/gpt-4o:nitro`. Or pass `online: true` for programmatic web search.

presence_penalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far. Between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values encourage new topics.

provider.description: OpenRouter provider-routing overrides. Merges on top of `OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_*` env defaults. See https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/provider-routing

only.description: Allow only these provider slugs for the request (e.g. `["anthropic","openai"]`). Env default: `OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ONLY`.

reasoning_effort.description: Control reasoning depth for thinking models (o1, o3, Claude extended thinking, etc.). Common values: `low`, `medium`, `high`. Higher effort = more reasoning tokens = better quality but slower and costlier. Passed through to the provider.

response_format.description: Request structured output. `{ "type": "json_object" }` forces valid JSON. `{ "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": { "name": "my_schema", "schema": {...} } }` enforces a specific JSON Schema. `{ "type": "text" }` is the default (plain text).

json_schema.description: Required when type is "json_schema". Must include "name" (string) and "schema" (JSON Schema object). Optional "strict" (boolean).

response_healing.description: Enable `openrouter:response_healing` — auto-fix malformed JSON (missing brackets, trailing commas, markdown wrappers). Reduces JSON defects by 80%+.

seed.description: Deterministic sampling seed for reproducible outputs. Repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. Pass a single string or an array of strings.

subagent.description: Enable `openrouter:subagent` — model can delegate subtasks to a smaller, cheaper worker model mid-generation. Pass `true` or `{model: "..."}` to specify the worker.

model.description: Worker model ID (default: auto-selected cheaper model).

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position, with their log probabilities. Requires `logprobs: true`. Between 0 and 20.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only tokens with top_p cumulative probability are considered. Alternative to temperature. Between 0 and 1.

web_blocked_domains.description: Block specific domains from web search results (e.g. `["reddit.com", "pinterest.com"]`).
